body:
My best friend and I took Molly at a party. We bought it in capsules and each took one by breaking it open and emptying the off-white powder onto our tounges. We took it before drinking some shots of vodka. The drug tasted pretty bad. We washed it down with copius amounts of water. It tastes very chemically.
Soon after that we began drinking. I had a couple shots and was feeling fine. Just relaxing, laughing, and waiting for everybody to arrive at the party. In about an hour I began to notice how much fun I was having. More fun than if I had just been drinking. Everybody looked amazing, people touching my skin felt so great. I was talking to everyone, everyone was talking to me. I felt like the life of the party. Everyone soon proceeded to dance and turn the strobelight on. It was amazing. Thats all I know how to describe it. It felt so good. Euphoric, if I may. We danced all night and talked, passed some joints around. Ecstatic. Chainsmoked and laughed for hours. The only problem was that my jaw movements were uncontrollable, but that side effect varies on the person.
It was so much fun and for days afterward I felt extremely happy. For no reason at all, it seemed like. There was no comedown for me. It is definitely a party drug. A few weeks later I popped thizz and I was not impressed at all. Molly is so much better.
Thizz is lame.
